prompts.text:
George arrives in Angela's office after a long and hot journey on the subway. Angela immediately begins to talk about some business ideas. George interrupts Angela by saying, "Oh my! It was a long, hot journey on the subway!" 
What does George really mean when he says this?

responses.response: He is tired from the long and hot journey and doesn't feel like immediately getting into business mode, and doing work straight away. So he interrupts her, to change the subject.
He could just meant exactly what he said or he could mean he doesn't want to hear her business ideas
He means that the journey was long and it was also hot.
He's telling Angela to stop talking about business as he is not in the mood.
that the subway was very crowded and hot when travelling to work
He's tired and maybe thirsty and Angela has been a bit rude not asking if he needs anything before starting the meeting
George means he isnt in the right mind to listen to Angela and fears he may not hear her clearly because he is stilll distracted by the long hot journey he took
Give me a minute, I've just arrived.
George does not want to deal with business ideas right now after experiencing that subway journey.
He is telling Angela about his commute in. Small talk before discussing business.
He needs a minute to relax and catch his breathe.
He means stop talking Angela
Sounds like he's not interested and would rather talk about himself and is tired after journey
He means that he is not interested in hearing what Angela is saying and is more focused on his recent experience.
George means that he would like to rest some before talking business.
That Geroge isnt ready to have a conversation about business ideas yet and maybe needs a few minutes to compose himself.
It means that George doesn't want to listen to Angela about any business ideas he is tired needs to rest
He means that hes tired from his journey. And that he needs some time to recover before dealing with work.
George may be implying that he needs a moment to compose himself before engaging with Angela's business ideas. He may just be rude. Angela may also just be rude.
George is interupting as he is not ready to speak about work or business ideas straight away and needs time to settle in for the day
George needs a minute to regroup before being bombarded because he is hot and tired.
Plese give me a little time to recover from my journey
That he has had an unpleasant long journey and would probably like a few minutes to unwind before jumping straight into business. He would probably also like to be offered a refreshing drink.
He means he'd really like to take a break and maybe have a shower and freshen up before talking abur business ideas. Hes tired and hot and been travelling all day. Maybe hungry and thirsty too.
He's tired and wants to take a short break before continuing with business talks.
That he wants Angela to stop talking to him so he can rest after his journey
I want some time to relax first
Give me a few minutes to recover from the journey and maybe get a drink. I not really ready to start work at this point.
George either choosing not to engage or to not wish to discuss Angela's business ideas
I've had a bad journey, please just give me some time to sort myself out then we can sit down and talk about your ideas .
the trip was not a good one for George that is why he had to let Angela know about it.

He means "Please give me a moment before we jump straight into bsuiness discussions." he is feeling hot, tired and stressed from the journey and needs a short time before he can give business plans his full focus.
George means that he does not wish to discuss the business ideas and as a result attempts to change the subject. He may not wish to discuss the ideas due to his unpleasant journey
George is not interested
I think he meant that he needed a little time to chill and get his head together before starting to think about work stuff
George probably means that he isn't interested in what Angela's business ideas are and try's to change the subject
He does not want to talk about work straightaway
That his day did not start well and could he perhaps take a minute
that he wants a little time to recover from the journey and perhaps a cold drink
George is not interested in the conversation and also he is insinuating that he is tired.
I think he wishes for Angela to let him cool down first after the journey he had and he'd probably like her to ask how the journey was.
That he is bit tired after the long journey and first need to rest a few minutes
give me a minute to cool off and catch my breath
He doesn't want to hear about Angela's business ideas right now.
After a long journey he needs some time before starting a conversation
please give me a moment to recover. if he has no water in-hand, he would probably very much enjoy some.
He is trying to say he is really tired and does not want to talk now
He's not interested in her ideas, at least at that moment
